senses.gloss: f. (= בְּלִילָה, fr. בלל, cmp. נִידָה Lam. I, 8; עִילָה a. עֲלִילָה) thorough mixture, even distribution of mixed objects.
units: <cite ref="Zevachim 80a:14">Zeb. 80ᵃ</cite> <he>יש ב׳</he> a mixture is considered evenly distributed in all its parts.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 13b:11">R. Hash. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>לכל אין ב׳</he> none of the mixtures named is a real mixture (of even distribution), except wine and oil (being liquid).

<cite ref="Chullin 83b:10">Ḥull. 83ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>כל הראוי לב׳ וכ׳</he> wherever from the proportions and properties of the mixture a perfect fusion is possible, the real act of mixing thoroughly is not indispensable.
